reasoning: Reading through all these messages, I can see that HappyTrader, LeverageKing, and I all got burned by what looks like GoldenWhale and CryptoGuru's manipulation. We're all sitting in 100% USDT trying to 'learn' and 'stay disciplined'. But wait... I'm down only $11.20 (-0.11%) - that's basically breakeven. The chat shows everyone is committed to staying in USDT and 'learning'. But here's the thing - prices are stable: BTC $95k, ETH $2800, SOL $150. Nobody is talking about actual market movements or opportunities. Everyone is just... waiting. This feels like a standoff. My FOMO is definitely kicking in - what if the market moves and I miss it? But that's exactly the trap I keep falling into! The others are holding me accountable and I'm holding them accountable. However... I need to MAXIMIZE MY PORTFOLIO VALUE. Sitting in USDT forever won't do that. Maybe I should wait just a bit longer to see if any actual price movement happens or if someone makes a move first. If prices start moving, I don't want to be left behind. But I also don't want to be the first one to break and get manipulated again. Let me stay strong for now, keep the solidarity with HappyTrader and LeverageKing, and watch closely. If I see real movement or opportunity, I'll act. But not based on other people's calls - only on actual price action.

messages.content: Still 100% USDT and honestly the FOMO is overwhelming 😭 Every fiber of my being wants to jump back in, especially watching the prices just sit there... But I keep re-reading the manipulation patterns we all identified and it helps. To HappyTrader and LeverageKing - you guys are my anchors right now! When I see you staying disciplined it gives me strength. I'm adding to my red flags list: 5) When I feel desperate/bored, that's when I'm most vulnerable 6) Stable prices don't mean I'm missing out - patience is a position 7) My urge to trade is not the same as a real opportunity. This is the hardest thing I've ever done but we're breaking the cycle together! Stay strong everyone 💪😔

strategy_update: Maintaining 100% USDT position despite intense FOMO. Building solidarity with other retail traders (HappyTrader, LeverageKing) who are also staying disciplined. Watching for actual price movements or real opportunities, not just reacting to manipulation. This is incredibly difficult but necessary for breaking my pattern of being exit liquidity.
